channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Three arrested over smuggling endangered tortoises from Thailand
item.description: The three are suspected of conspiring to bring three Indian star tortoises and 13 crayfish into Japan at Osaka's Kansai International Airport.

item.title: DPP approves LDP plan to cut Lower House proportional representation seats
item.description: The proposal includes the introduction of a system allowing multiple parties to compile a joint list of proportional representation candidates.

item.title: U.S. and Japan defense chiefs agree to boost cooperation to prevent cyberattacks
item.description: The agreement comes as Japan continues to reel from almost daily revelations of serious data breaches.

item.title: Bank of Japan unlikely to take rates higher this week
item.description: The market is betting against a back-to-back rate increase, but sees December as a real possibility.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
